{{Otheruses|Deep Core}}
The '''Deep Core Haulers''' were a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-licensed [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] that hauled cargo into the [[Deep Core Security Zone/Legends|Deep Core Security Zone]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] located within. To obtain a license, the captain was required to register with the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] as an authorized Deep Core traveler, as well as receive an [[Imperial Security]] [[Imperial Security Authorization|authorization]] and an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Imperial Intelligence Clearance|clearance]] to ensure they had done no Rebel contracting. Serving as a Deep Core hauler was a quick way to gain or regain legitimacy, as clearance included immunity from prosecution for petty crimes. The Deep Core hauler system also served to weaken the smugglers' compact formed by [[Talon Karrde]].
